Our guiding principles / 04

AI forward. Human at the heart.

We believe the best technology makes people more capable. These principles guide how we explore AI and every solution we recommend.

01 / USEFUL

Innovation with a purpose.

We embrace AI and new tools when they solve a real problem, save time, or make everyday technology easier to use.

02 / HUMAN

People stay in control.

Technology should support human judgment and creativity. We keep people involved in important decisions and outcomes.

03 / RESPONSIBLE
